newsitem.title: USA: Ameritech cellular customers grow in '96.
newsitem.headline: Ameritech cellular customers grow in '96.

text.p: Ameritech Corp said Monday the number of its cellular customers grew 33 percent to 2.5 million in 1996 compared with a year ago.
Its paging customers grew 53 percent to 1.14 million, it added.
Earlier, Ameritech reported fourth quarter earnings of $1.00 before one-time items, up from $0.90 in the 1995 period.
Ameritech also said it saw a 9.5 percent growth in network access minutes of use for the year, and a 3.4 percent annual increase in access lines to 19.7 million.
It also reported a 23.5 percent annual growth in sales of call management services such as caller identification, call waiting and voice messaging.

"By executing our strategy of speeding growth in our core communications business while investing in high-growth businesses such as security monitoring, cable TV and international opportunities, we've sustained double-digit growth while strongly positioning Ameritech for the future," Richard Notebaert, chairman, said in a statement.
